notes.title: First update of 2024 - New Powerups!
notes.notes:
A lot of new powerups has been introduced, opening up the possibility for quite ridiculous builds :).

I've worked some on the visuals adding a lot of lights on different objects, also improved things like explosions.

Several minor bugs has been fixed, like the score screen showing the wrong amount of bullets.

Several tweaks to the gameplay in order to make it as enjoyable as possible to play.

// Jesper Ringqvist
